title: Bulk Handling Equipment - Reclaimer - Data Sheet for Bucket Wheel Reclaimer (Rail Mounted), Part 2: Information to be Supplied by the Purchaser
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the data required for selection of rail mounted scraper reclaimer.

clause_3_terminology: Data Sheet for Bucket Wheel Reclaimer
Part 2: Information to be Supplied by the Purchaser

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
